title: Tee Higgins left Sunday's loss with an adductor injury

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Tee Higgins left Sunday's loss with an adductor injury
sources.description: Bengals wide receiver Tee Higgins had the second-most receiving yards he's ever had in a single game on Sunday, but he wasn't able to help the Bengals try to win the game at the end of the fourth quarter.
